title: The jars, the first of the year
logline: The four jars on the sill on the first walk-less morning of 2027, the sand dollar, the rain not yet started, the pup's bed empty because he's on the step deciding. The last year's first page.

panels.composition: A garage window sill with four jars and a sand dollar in gray morning light, the rain not yet started, a dog bed below empty.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage window sill with four jars and a small sand dollar in gray morning light before rain with an empty dog bed below, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
